</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_26_1489458216313_50804"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">travel info</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">KiteParadise is located on the North shore of Madagascar, 20km away from Diego Suarez City (Antsiranana in Malagasy).</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Get to Diego Suarez</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Approx 300€ round ticket for the domestic flight from <strong>Antananarivo</strong> to <strong>Diego</strong> (<a href="https://madagascarairlines.com/" target="_blank">MADAGASCAR AIRLINES</a>)<br>Please note that if you want to pay with your credit card on their website, you have to select € as your currency on their welcome screen.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">By international flight from <strong>La Reunion</strong> (<a href="https://www.air-austral.com/" target="_blank">Air Austral</a>) or <strong>Mayotte</strong> (<a href="http://www.ewa-air.com/en/" target="_blank">EWA</a>). </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From Antananarivo, by road, a chartered van will cost you 600€ or the taxi brousse. The road condition is really rough and the trip usually takes 24h.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From <strong>Nosy Be</strong>, you first take the <strong>boat to Ankify</strong> (approximately <strong>1 hour</strong>), then continue by car from <strong>Ankify</strong> to our place (approximately <strong>6 hours</strong>).</p></li></ul><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>TIP:</strong>&nbsp;<em>Coming from Asia, </em><a href="https://www.kenya-airways.com" target="_blank"><em>Kenya Airways</em></a><em> is offering very good fares with a stopover in Nairobi whereas </em><a href="https://www.airmauritius.com/index_au.htm?gclid=Cj0KCQjw9NbdBRCwARIsAPLsnFaaGBWvoCrzDJS8q3Y-MSNJSJOUeWu09uEjaK8T2z75OK1PVI3MF2waAuj-EALw_wcB" target="_blank"><em>Air Mauritius</em></a><em> will do a stopover in Mauritius and </em><a href="https://www.ethiopianairlines.com/AA/EN" target="_blank"><em>Ethiopian Airlines</em></a><em> will do a stopover in Addis Ababa.</em><br><br><strong>TIP: </strong><em>Nosy Be is a beautiful island part of Madagascar, laying on the Mozambique canal. It is only 1 hour away from the West coast by ferry and then 6 hours away from Diego by road. As it is a very touristic place there are plenty of airlines going to Nosy Be from Europe and mostly from Italy.</em></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Get to Antananarivo (Tana) first</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air Austral </strong>From Saint–Denis de la Réunion</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air France </strong>From Paris–Charles de Gaulle</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Airlink </strong>From Johannesburg–OR Tambo</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Emirates (from September 2024)</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Madagascar Airlines </strong>We don’t recommend AT ALL this airline for international flights. They are ok for the domestic ones.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air Mauritius </strong>From Mauritius</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air Seychelles </strong>From Mahé (end on 24 April 2018)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Comores Aviation </strong>From Anjouan, Moroni</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Corsair International </strong>From Paris–Orly, Saint–Denis de la Réunion</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Ethiopian Airlines </strong>From Addis Ababa</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kenya Airways </strong>From Nairobi–Jomo Kenyatta</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>LOT Polish Airlines </strong>From Warsaw–Chopin</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Turkish Airlines </strong>From Istanbul–Atatürk</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Get to Nosy Be first</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air Austral </strong>From Dzaoudzi-Pamandzi, La Réunion R. <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">deposit and cancellation fees</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">To confirm your reservation, we normally require a <strong>50% deposit of the total accommodation amount</strong>.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">For <strong>last-minute bookings</strong>, depending on the arrival date and room availability, we may require <strong>100% prepayment</strong> to secure and confirm the reservation.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Groups (from 4 rooms) will have to pay the balance not later than 45 days before their stay.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>1 - IF YOU CANCEL THE WHOLE STAY</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Cancellation fees : cancellation of one or two rooms</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">45 days or beyond before the trip — the deposit is fully reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">44 to 30 days before the trip — 75% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">29 to 22 days before the trip — 50% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">21 to 15 days before the trip — 25% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">14 days or less before the trip — the deposit will not be reimbursed</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Cancellation fees : cancellation of three rooms or more</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">60 days or beyond before the trip — the deposit is fully reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">59 to 52 days before the trip — 75% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">51 to 45 days before the trip — 50% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">44 to 31 days before the trip — 25% of the deposit is reimbursed</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">30 days or less before the trip — the deposit will not be reimbursed</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>2 - IF YOU COME BUT CANCEL SOME NIGHTS</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Cancellation fees : cancellation of one or two rooms</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">45 days or beyond before the trip — you won’t have to pay any penalties</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">44 to 30 days before the trip — 25% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">29 to 22 days before the trip — 50% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">21 to 15 days before the trip — 75% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">14 days or less before the trip — 100% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Cancellation fees : cancellation of three rooms or more</strong></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">60 days or beyond before the trip — you won’t have to pay any penalties</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">59 to 52 days before the trip — 25% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">51 to 45 days before the trip — 50% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">44 to 31 days before the trip — 75% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">30 days or less before the trip — 100% penalty of the nights you cancelled</p></li></ul><p style="text-align:right;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><a href="#here">BACK</a></p>
